SELECT t.id, t.request_id, t.user_id, t.username, t.session_id, t.python_session_id, t.business_type, t.entrypoint, t.status, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.started_at, t.ended_at, t.duration_ms, t.created_at, COALESCE(step_counts.step_count, 0) AS step_count, COALESCE(llm_counts.llm_call_count, 0) AS llm_call_count, COALESCE(llm_counts.total_tokens, 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(llm_counts.failed_llm_calls, 0) AS failed_llm_calls, COALESCE(llm_counts.fallback_used, FALSE) AS fallback_used FROM t_ai_trace t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trace_id, COUNT(*) AS step_count FROM t_ai_trace_step GROUP BY trace_id ) step_counts ON step_counts.trace_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trace_id, COUNT(*) AS llm_call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'SUCCESS') AS failed_llm_calls, BOOL_OR(fallback_used) AS fallback_used FROM t_ai_llm_call GROUP BY trace_id ) llm_counts ON llm_counts.trace_id = t.id
ORDER BY t.started_at DESC, t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, request_id, user_id, username, session_id, python_session_id, business_type, entrypoint, status, error_code, error_message, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, metadata::text AS metadata_json, created_at FROM t_ai_trace WHERE id = #{traceId}

SELECT id, trace_id, step_order, step_type, step_name, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, metadata::text AS metadata_json, error_message, created_at FROM t_ai_trace_step WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY step_order ASC, started_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, trace_id, step_id, call_type, provider, model, fallback_used, fallback_from_model, status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, token_source, prompt_cache_hit_tokens, prompt_cache_miss_tokens, prompt_cache_hit_rate, cache_reported_by_provider, latency_ms, raw_usage_json::text AS raw_usage_json, metadata::text AS metadata_json, error_message, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM t_ai_llm_call WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS trace_count, COUNT(c.id) AS total_llm_calls, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status <> 'SUCCESS') AS failed_llm_calls, COALESCE(SUM(c.prompt_tokens), 0) AS total_prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(c.completion_tokens), 0) AS total_completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(c.total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(AVG(c.latency_ms), 0) AS average_latency_ms, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cache_reported_by_provider THEN c.prompt_cache_hit_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS provider_prompt_cache_hit_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cache_reported_by_provider THEN c.prompt_cache_miss_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS provider_prompt_cache_miss_tokens, COUNT(c.id) FILTER ( WHERE c.cache_reported_by_provider AND COALESCE(c.prompt_cache_hit_tokens, 0) > 0 ) AS provider_prompt_cache_hit_calls, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.cache_reported_by_provider) AS provider_cache_reported_calls, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.cache_reported_by_provider) AS provider_cache_unreported_calls FROM t_ai_trace t LEFT JOIN t_ai_llm_call c ON c.trace_id = t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_observability_access_log (admin_user_id, trace_id, llm_call_id, access_type, request_uri, ip_address, user_agent) VALUES (#{log.adminUserId}, #{log.traceId}, #{log.llmCallId}, #{log.accessType}, #{log.requestUri}, #{log.ipAddress}, #{log.userAgent})
